nodes.label: archive Specification
nodes.description: Main OpenSpec spec for the archive capability (created by archiving build-cooking-hub)

nodes.label: Archive grid (archive)
nodes.description: `/recipes` SHALL show every recipe matching the current filters as a card: hero image (or the designed placeholder), title (clamped to 2 lines), 2–3 lines of description (clamped to 3), total time (prep + cook; none when both are empty) and tags. Cards SHALL enter staggered (each card's entrance delay larger than the previous one's). With no recipes at all the page SHALL show an empty state with "
scenarios: Cards show image, title, description, time and tags
Empty archive invites the first recipe
Card without description shows title and meta
Long titles and descriptions are clamped
Card without image shows the placeholder
Recipe without times shows no time on its card
Cards enter staggered
Reduced motion shows cards without entrance animation
Card entrance looks lively and calm

nodes.label: Featured stack (archive)
nodes.description: The archive header SHALL show "Featured": the 7 most recently added recipes (newest first) as a stacked card carousel with a `01/07` counter, prev/next arrows, swipe on touch and Left/Right arrow keys when the stack has focus. It SHALL show what exists when there are fewer (`01/03`), hide when there are none, show no arrows for a single recipe, and not change with the filters.
scenarios: Featured query returns the seven newest recipes
Featured stack shows the seven newest
Featured with fewer than seven counts what exists
Single featured recipe has no arrows
Arrows and keyboard step through the stack
Swipe steps through the stack on phone
Featured stack ignores the filters
Featured stack looks like a coverflow

nodes.label: Filters (archive)
nodes.description: A chip row SHALL list the tags; selecting several SHALL show recipes having all of them. A "Favourites" toggle SHALL show only favourites. A live count ("12 recipes", "1 recipe") SHALL follow every change. With no match the page SHALL show "No recipes match" and "Clear filters". The filter state (tags, favourites, search, sort) SHALL live in the URL (`?tags=<ids>&fav=1&q=<text>&sort=<newest|title|
scenarios: Several tags show recipes having all of them
Tag filter requires all tags on the server
Favourites-only toggle
No match offers to clear filters
Filter state survives reload and back
Filtered cards glide to new positions
Reduced motion filters without gliding
Filter gliding looks smooth

nodes.label: Search (archive)
nodes.description: A search field SHALL search title, description, ingredient names and tag names, case-insensitively including non-ASCII letters (`spätzle` finds "Käse-Spätzle"), combined with the tag filter (AND). An empty query SHALL show all recipes; no match SHALL show the same empty state as the filters.
scenarios: Search covers title, description, ingredients and tags
Search ignores case for umlauts
Empty search returns all recipes
Search combines with the tag filter
Search from the archive
Search without match shows the empty state

nodes.label: Sort (archive)
nodes.description: The archive SHALL sort by newest (default), title A–Z (case- and accent-aware) or total time (ascending, recipes without time last).
scenarios: Newest first by default
Sort by title
Sort by total time puts recipes without time last
Sort choice in the archive

nodes.label: Favourites (archive)
nodes.description: A heart toggle on each card and on the recipe page SHALL switch the favourite flag (`aria-pressed`), record when it was favourited and animate.
scenarios: Favourite toggles on a card
Favourite toggle feels alive
